# Candice Kuit

> Candice Kuit is a hair and makeup artist based in Cape Town, South Africa. She works with brides under the name The Makeup Company, with a skin-first approach to soft glam, and is known for her work with mature skin. She also works across editorial, campaign, television and film, and is represented for commercial work by One League Creative Management.

Page: https://bookednow.co.za/candice/
